What it does

Birdeye automates the two things that drive local trade work: reviews and listings. It requests reviews after jobs, keeps business details consistent across directories, and uses AI to draft responses. It is contract-priced and not cheap for a one-van operation, but review volume is one of the few marketing levers with a direct local effect.

Where the AI actually is

AI drafts review responses and suggests review request timing.

Pros

  • Systematically builds review volume
  • Manages listings across directories
  • Automates review requests after jobs

Cons

  • Contract pricing; not cheap for a single-truck operation

Who it suits

Built with Plumbers, Electricians, HVAC, Roofers in mind. Businesses that depend on local search and online reviews.
